name: dsh-se-skills
description: SE (Systems Engineer / Application Architect) workflow skills for the DeepSeek Harness (dsh): 16 skills covering Define → Design → Document → Verify → Validate, plus 6 /se-* entry commands, 5 review personas, 3 native budget tools (se_budget_rollup / se_budget_check / se_budget_bottleneck), and locally vendored drawio / math MCP servers. Skills under ./skills are provider-served live; ./commands, ./agents and ./lib/tools are registered by the plugin (lib/index.js). Install with `dsh plugin --profile web add link:<this dir>` (see docs/dsh-setup.md).

scripts.verify: npm run validate && npm run smoke
